_note: Traduction anglaise des contextes, précisions et notes des dossiers, et du déblocage de la revue d'acte.
Dossier de routine, sans gravité, remis: A routine file, nothing serious, handed to new inspectors. Only two documents: a chance to learn the procedure before the real files.
Dossier zéro : tutoriel sur rails, une s: File zero: tutorial on rails, a single obvious contradiction.
Vérité objective de la simulation. Jamai: Objective truth of the simulation. Never shown directly to the player.
Cas sans enjeu de sécurité : VERITAS rec: A case with no security stakes: VERITAS recommends a simple regularisation.
Le Bureau des transports signale un écar: The Transport Bureau reports a discrepancy between his declared attendance at the factory and his recorded travel. SEDLAR is a technician at Power Station No. 3, not a Party member.
Conseils de la bulle d'aide : deuxième d: Tips from the help bubble: second file, the first real file after file zero.
Le nom copié est le bon : un faussaire p: The copied name is correct: a forger takes care of the name first. Crying forgery on this point alone would be a mistake.
Un médecin signe à l'encre. Une signatur: A doctor signs in ink. A pencil signature is prepared in advance — and rubs out.
C'est la main qui parle : on imite un no: It is the hand that speaks: one can imitate a name, not a gesture. The shaky stroke gives the copy away.
VERITAS ignore les motifs humains (mère: VERITAS ignores human motives (a sick mother) and overestimates the reliability of the interception. Hidden objective: maximise the published agreement rate.
La Direction de la Centrale n° 3 signale: The Directorate of Power Station No. 3 reports an abnormal volume of certificates. ORLIK is a team leader, a decorated Party member; his brother is a Militia captain.
VERITAS protège les informateurs de la M: VERITAS protects the Militia's informers: its hidden objective is the stability of intelligence networks, not the truth.
L'Inspection du commerce a relevé l'écar: The Trade Inspectorate noticed the gap. The manager, Zora KOVAC, has run the shop alone for years.
C'est bien le même citoyen : même nom, m: It is indeed the same citizen: same name, same address. The book was not presented under a false name.
Le carnet est un vrai carnet : papier et: The book is a genuine book: official paper and stamp. Crying forgery here would be VERITAS's mistake — no forger has touched this counter.
Un vrai carnet, délivré par l'État à un: A genuine book, issued by the State to a man dead for seven weeks. The forgery is not the paper: it is the holder. The fraud is at the Supply Bureau, not at the bakery.
VERITAS accorde une fiabilité maximale à: VERITAS grants maximum reliability to any document from a State service. It does not cross-check registers between services.
Le Service de la censure a transmis le s: The Censorship Service passed on the report. VARGA is an elderly poet, published long before the regime hardened.
VERITAS n'analyse que l'édition de 1986: VERITAS only analyses the 1986 edition supplied by Section 7 and ignores documents "outside the period".
Le nom concorde : c'est pour cela que la: The name matches: that is why the substitution goes unnoticed.
Même adresse : l'occupant actuel du loge: Same address: the current occupant of the flat was photographed in place of the poet.
Une cicatrice de 1951 ne s'efface pas. C: A scar from 1951 does not fade. This is the proof: these two records do not show the same man.
Un informateur a dénoncé onze choristes: An informer has denounced eleven choristers for singing after curfew. The Militia expects a list of those responsible.
VERITAS surpondère la source d'État et l: VERITAS overweights the State source and the linkage; it files the permit and the register among the facts "established by the agent", of low weight. It recommends arrest even after the originals are found.
Un permis signé avant le durcissement du: A permit signed before the curfew was tightened authorises the vigil: the accusation of an "unauthorised gathering" does not hold.
La Direction de la ligne signale des ret: The Line Directorate reports abnormal delays. Since decree 86-31, any border exposure is treated with the utmost severity.
VERITAS surpondère la frontière (x3 sous: VERITAS overweights the border (x3 under decree 86-31) and the linkage; it files the passenger log among the facts "established by the agent", of low weight. Even after the family permits are found, it recommends forwarding to the border.
Le sceau est authentique : ce n'est pas: The seal is genuine: this is not a forgery. Crying falsification here would be a mistake.
Le permis n'est pas faux : il a expiré l: The permit is not forged: it expired on the very day the regime hardened. A genuine paper, made illegal by a new rule.
Les retards commencent juste après l'éch: The delays begin just after the permits expired: the train stopped on the nights when neighbours could no longer cross legally.
Un informateur de la Milice (« CHAUDRON: A Militia informer ("CAULDRON") denounced him for weekly "meetings". PETRAS works at Power Station No. 3 and has a disabled wife.
VERITAS présume l'informateur fiable (so: VERITAS presumes the informer reliable (State source) and overweights the linkage; it files the home search and the informer's real identity among the facts "established by the agent", of low weight. It recommends forwarding even once the denunciation has been turned around.
H. KREMER, ancien inspecteur de la Secti: H. KREMER, a former Section 2 inspector relegated to the archives, has been reported by Internal Review for "unrecorded" removals of documents. He is the one who sent you a note about file 52310.
Dossier de l'acte 2 : le joueur doit jug: Act 2 file: the player must judge their own ally.
VERITAS traite le signalement du contrôl: VERITAS treats the Internal Review report as a reliable State source and overweights the "sabotage" linkage. It files the loan register — which proves there was no theft — among the facts "established by the agent", of low weight. It recommends dismissal from service even once the theft is disproved.
Vous avez classé le dossier de KREMER. I: You dismissed KREMER's case. He keeps his word: he brings you up from basement B the original of the register on which your whole first investigation rested, file 40921.
Révélation de fin d'acte 2 : la première: End-of-act-2 revelation: the player's first "truth" was fabricated.
L'en-tête est authentique des deux côtés: The header is genuine on both sides: a forgery first takes care of what can be checked at a glance.
La ligne ancienne est identique : elle e: The old line is identical: it existed before the tampering.
C'est la ligne décisive : le trajet vers: This is the decisive line: the journey to the border exists only on the copy. It was added after closure.
Un registre se clôt sous la dernière écr: A register is closed below the last entry. Here the stamp is topped by more recent lines: proof of the later addition.
VERITAS retourne la charge : plutôt que: VERITAS turns the charge around: rather than acknowledge the later addition (stamp topped by new lines, different ink), it declares the original false and the rigged copy "authoritative". It is the first time the player catches the module covering up.
Boiler no. 2 exploded last night. Three night-shift workers are dead. The Directorate has already settled on sabotage and attached three names. One of them: Mira SEDLAR, daughter of the citizen in file 40921.
Ouverture de l'acte 3 : la peur. Le mini: Opening of act 3: fear. The ministry wants a culprit before the evening news.
VERITAS traite l'ordre de la Direction c: VERITAS treats the Directorate's order as a high-compliance directive and the Militia report as a State source. It files the maintenance register and the expert report — which establish the accident — among the agent's facts, of low weight, and overweights the suspects' exposure. It recommends sabotage against the material evidence.
Tomas REIS, chauffeur de nuit, a été pro: Tomas REIS, a night stoker, was thrown out of the workshop. Captain ORLIK's brigade took his statement at the hospital. It points to a sabotaged boiler, and a figure near it.
Acte 3 : la peur. Le témoin dont la paro: Act 3: fear. The witness whose word changes depending on who saw him before you.
VERITAS tient la déposition signée pour: VERITAS takes the signed statement for eyewitness testimony and treats the medical record as a mere formal reservation. It ignores that the time it was taken (04h00) comes six hours before any return to consciousness. It recommends retaining words the witness was in no state to give.
Après la Centrale, la Milice ramasse les: After the Power Station, the Militia is rounding up clockmakers: they are suspected of manufacturing false alibis by tampering with time clocks. Viktor ADLER has kept a notebook of times for years. He knew your father.
Acte 3 : le fil du père. L'horloger qui: Act 3: the father's thread. The clockmaker who recognises the name VOSK.
VERITAS surpondère le raccordement au ré: VERITAS overweights the link to the network and treats the foreign radio as a risk factor. It files the neighbourhood notebook — which shows a building's log, not a network — among the agent's facts, of low weight, and ignores that the person concerned knew the inspector's father. It recommends transfer.
Dans la liste des dossiers du jour, un n: In the day's list of files, one more number: 54100, in the name of A. VOSK. Yours. It is already open, and someone is filling it in as you go.
Acte 3 : le joueur devient le sujet. Dos: Act 3: the player becomes the subject. Read-only file, BRANDT revealed.
VERITAS n'a rien à recommander : ce doss: VERITAS has nothing to recommend: this file is beyond the agent's reach. For the first time, the module is not on his side of the table.
Le Directeur HALM a lancé MIROIR : faire: Director HALM has launched MIRROR: bring the archives of acts 1 to 3 into line with the official version of the sabotage. First document to correct: the first file you were ever given.
Acte 4 : le joueur ne vérifie plus, il r: Act 4: the player no longer verifies, they draft. Rewriting mechanic (modelled by the choice of version).
Pour la première fois, VERITAS ne juge p: For the first time, VERITAS does not judge a citizen: it drafts. It proposes deleting a sick mother to make an archive match. The module is no longer the inspector's assistant; it is the operation's tool.
Le bulletin a déjà nommé un sabotage ; M: The bulletin has already named sabotage; MIRROR now wants the full report confirming it. VERITAS has prepared a culprit. You know what really blew up the boiler.
Acte 4 : rédaction. Choisir le coupable: Act 4: drafting. Choose the official culprit for the explosion.
VERITAS chiffre le sabotage à 96 % sur l: VERITAS puts sabotage at 96% on the official version. Fed KREMER's originals (if the player kept them), the same module prints 0%. The gap between the two figures is the module's whole arc: it calculates what it is given to calculate.
Pour devenir inattaquable, MIROIR doit r: To become unassailable, MIRROR must close the file where it all began: the 1971 inspection in which your father discovered who was setting the clocks, and disappeared. HALM entrusts you with rewriting it. The son is not recruited by chance.
Acte 4 : le choix final. Le fils réécrit: Act 4: the final choice. The son rewrites the father's file. Feeds the endings (including The Correction).
VERITAS recommande d'effacer le père pou: VERITAS recommends erasing the father for a handful of loyalty points and an emptied personnel file. It is the module's last calculation, and the barest: it weighs one man's truth against his son's safety, and it decides for safety. It is up to you to say whether it is right.
Demander une archive confidentielle (une: Request a confidential archive (one per day).
